phase: reference, repeat, and kill-then-continue of the same staged target
detail: An uninterrupted baseline run compared with one killed mid-turn and then re-run. The baseline cannot continue a run — its position is a local variable — so the second process started the job again from the plan, which makes the comparison one between a single pass and a *second* pass. That is why the verdict is taken from the second-pass control below: two clean runs over one target, no kill. If the killed run matches an unkilled second pass, the interruption added nothing to the product; if it does not, the difference is the interruption's and is reported as such. Compared: the same file set, with the same SHA-256 per file, at the same relative path — every regular file under the target except .durable/ (the store, which differs by construction) and the harness's build directory.
